source_text: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
child_paraphrase: Do not forget to do good and to share with others. God is pleased when we give.
license_note: Short quotation of the 1769 Oxford King James Version. That edition is public domain in the United States. No bulk copyrighted Bible text is used.
lock_note: Issue #6 Mission 5 lock: Share the Harvest. KJV 'communicate' is locked as sharing/giving, not modern talking.
forbidden_claims: Do not invent extra narrative as scripture
Do not treat harvest baskets or neighbor porches as facts from this verse
Do not read 'communicate' as 'talk more'; this verse is about doing good and sharing
Do not add verses, names, or events that are not in Hebrews 13:16
